summary: Century Therapeutics furnished an 8-K on October 2, 2026, disclosing a press release and presentation slides covering nonclinical data for CNTY-813, its iPSC-derived islet replacement therapy for type 1 diabetes, presented at the European Association for the Study of Diabetes meeting in Milan. The filing includes Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01, with Exhibit 99.1 press release and Exhibit 99.2 slides. Management reaffirmed the CNTY-813 IND submission remains on track for Q4 2026, with initial clinical data anticipated in the second half of 2027. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural terms were disclosed; this is a routine product/science update rather than a special situation.
